item.title: Fundamentals of Asynchronous Programming: Async, Await ... - Learn Rust
item.description: Running async code in Rust usually happens concurrently. Depending on the hardware, the operating system, and the async runtime we are using (more on async runtimes shortly), that concurrency may also use parallelism under the hood. Now, let’s dive into how async programming in Rust actually works.

item.description: Writing your async code in a runtime-agnostic fashion requires conditional compilation, compatibility layers and handling edge-cases. This is the rationale behind most libraries gravitating towards the One True Runtime — Tokio. Executor coupling is a big problem for async Rust as it breaks the ecosystem into silos.
